text:
laura: Quick idea — telemetry-backed 'routebook' saved-sets that keep per-route / per-model filters in sync with routing + quota hints. Could reduce manual drift between routes and savedviews.

mike: Wait, so if infra pins a new model for a route, the user's saved view updates automatically?

laura: Ideally yes, but controlled. We surface the delta first and let teams opt-in per-route. Also show quota/cost preview before apply.

sam: @laura API question: do you want server-side authoritative sync or client reconcile with a merge UI?

mike: Server-side reconcile seems safer. We can attach a `routebook_id` to saved_query rows and have a background job apply diffs.

anita: UX constraints: must show an "auto-synced" badge and an undo history. Also need a compact diff preview overlay, not a full modal.

nate: Telemetry note: record `routebook.sync.preview_tokens`, `routebook.sync.applied`, and `routebook.sync.rollback` with sample sizes. We should capture token burn delta and model-accuracy regressions tied to the apply_event_id.

sam: Proto idea for the internal API: `POST /api/v1/internal/routebooks/:id/apply` body `{ "scope": "route|org", "dry_run": true, "max_cost_delta_pct": 10 }`. Reconcile job is idempotent and emits an apply_event id.

mike: Quota-safety: what if cost jumps? suggest we only auto-apply when token delta < 5% for first-rollout (org-admin configurable). Otherwise require explicit apply.

laura: Rollout plan: org-admin opt-in -> per-route admin opt-in -> default-off for 2 weeks -> reassess. Also add a TTL window for auto-applies to avoid stale diffs.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for `routebook-sync` service in eu-west-1 :rocket: 

anita: I'll ship a couple compact mockups showing the diff inline in the savedviews panel and a tiny cost delta chip next to fields.

sam: I'll spike the reconcile worker and push an RFC summarizing the API + job semantics (idempotency, backoff, event ids). Will link RFC here.

laura: Action items: sam spike + RFC, anita mockups, nate telemetry metric defs, mike implement quota-safety rule and cost preview.

mike: :white_check_mark: i'll add the safety flag and a small simulator to test cost deltas via playback telemetry.

laura: Also add unit tests for reconcile idempotency and an e2e that covers apply + rollback path.

sam: noted — will include integration tests for event-driven apply and an explicit `rollback` endpoint.

laura: Thanks everyone — let's reconvene after spikes.

mike: quick follow: should we expose a per-savedview audit log column `routebook_apply_event`? helps support.

laura: yes, good call — include that in the RFC.
